messages:
Mia: FYI incoming SEV from BrightCart — dedicated capacity, prod, big spike ~09:23 UTC, customer seeing sustained 429s and long tail latency. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BC-4123
Lina: How bad? can we ping them and get a snippet of the exact errors?
Mia: "429 Too Many Requests" and some 503s. Customer says scaling didn't bring capacity up for ~4m. I attached their request trace and the curl they used.
Mia: repro curl they ran: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate```
Omar: Looking at autoscaler metrics for that tenant — attach_queue length jumped, attach_latch_inflight stayed at ~60, attach_success rate dropped. Looks like probes started, didn't finish.
Jin: Any auth errors in attach service? that would block handshakes.
Mia: paste from attach logs (trimmed): ```[09:23:12] attach_request tenant=brightcart id=abc123 status=issued
[09:23:13] attach_probe tenant=brightcart id=abc123 -> probe:start
[09:23:13] attach_probe tenant=brightcart id=abc123 -> error: authz: token_churn 401
[09:23:14] attach_probe tenant=brightcart id=def456 -> probe:start
[09:23:14] attach_probe tenant=brightcart id=def456 -> timeout waiting for billing: hold
[09:23:30] attach_latch timeout id=abc123 -> orphaned
```
Omar: Huh. Seeing a short window where Billing service returned transient "account_hold" and auth service churned tokens (401). Probes got stuck waiting for billing ack and never cleaned up — looks like orphaned probes reduced concurrency headroom so scaler couldn't allocate more pods.
BillingBot: alert: billing-service responded 429 to /validate for tenant brightcart between 09:23:13-09:23:18 — rate-limited (quota spike).
Lina: Customer says they had a billing card rotation job around that time. could be related.
Jin: If probes are orphaned, autoscaler sees them as in-flight and refuses to exceed concurrency cap. We're hitting a semaphore leak in attach pipeline. Not the usual warm-pool/imagepull issue.
Omar: Quick mitigation idea: temporarily increase attach_concurrency and headroom for brightcart and lower probe_timeout to force faster failover. Also increase min_replicas to 6 from 2 while we patch.
Mia: Can we do that as a targeted config change? customer is on Dedicated.
Jin: Yes, we can push a tenant-config change — I'll prepare a canary. patch config snippet: ```{
  "tenant": "brightcart",
  "min_replicas": 6,
  "attach_concurrency": 120,
  "probe_timeout_ms": 8000
}```
Omar: Also adding a cleanup path to reclaim orphaned probe slots after Xs. I'll open an internal PR.
Mia: Repro steps for SRE: 1) rotate billing token quickly to emulate transient 429 on /validate 2) run load script (attached) that spikes concurrent attach requests 3) watch attach_latch_inflight and autoscaler headroom
Mia: load script example: ```#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
Lina: I'll keep the customer posted and offer the targeted config change as immediate remedial.
BillingBot: note: billing team throttled validate endpoint due to high throughput at 09:23; increasing validate QPS limit by 2x might be needed.
Jin: Plan: 1) apply tenant config bump (min_replicas + attach_concurrency) — immediate 2) deploy a probe-orphan watchdog fix (rollback-safe) — short PR 3) billing to increase validate QPS or add token backoff 4) postmortem + customer blameless summary
Omar: I'm taking on the watchdog PR. assigning to @jin for config change. Mia/Lina please confirm before I apply.
Mia: confirmed. apply change now and monitor.
DeployBot: rolling tenant config change for brightcart -> min_replicas=6, attach_concurrency=120 (canary 10% first)
DeployBot: canary success. scaling observed: new pods provisioned, attach_latch_inflight reduced from ~60 -> 10, attach_queue drained.
Mia: Customer reports error rate dropping to near-zero within 90s after canary applied.
Lina: I'll file communications and include repro steps + mitigation.
Jin: Follow-up: we should add metrics that count orphaned probes and expose per-tenant probe_wait_time. filing followup ticket ENGR-8204.
Omar: Adding timeline notes for postmortem. Closing this slack thread once PR merged.
Mia: thanks team :thumbsup:
